data_description.asleep_level: While asleep, only with "Screen off while asleep" off.
data_description.away_level: While the presence entity says nobody is home. Comes before day, evening and dark room.
data_description.back_to_page_1_off: The screen turns "Back to page 1" on again after every restart and firmware update. On: Tessera Control turns it off each time, also without the rotation. Off: only the rotation keeps it off.
data_description.dark_level: After sunset, while every room light is off.
data_description.day_level: Brightness level 1, 2 or 3 while the sun is up.
data_description.evening_level: After sunset, while at least one room light is on (or without room lights).
data_description.pause_minutes: How long the rotation waits after a page button was pressed.
data_description.presence_entity: On or home while someone is home. Without it, someone is always home.
data_description.room_lights: After sunset the room counts as dark when all of them are off. Without lights, the room is never dark.
data_description.sleep_entity: On while you sleep: the rotation rests and the screen goes off.
data_description.sleep_screen_off: Off: the screen stays on at the level for asleep instead.

options.when: When an entity is in one of these states
